description: CICE boundary traces from an instrumented D-class CESM run (PLAN.md 10.4 M3), default-gated by dump_cice=.false. and enabled in this run only: (a) D-boundary pointwise laws - EVP stress tensor law (ice_dyn_evp stress, standard_2d; strain_rates -> visc_replpress -> relaxation update, one row per (T cell, corner, subcycle ksub)), EVP momentum law (stepu in ice_dyn_shared; vrel/Cb/cca/ccb/ab2/cc1/cc2 chain and final uvel/vvel, one row per (U cell, ksub), U cell = NE corner of traced T cell so rows exist only where ice covers the U point), ice strength P (ice_strength law), mushy-layer freezing temperature Tf(sss) (shr_frz_freezetemp under CESMCOUPLED), albedo and thermo-flux laws; (b) I boundaries - coupling-step imports (post-ice_import) and exports (actual ESMF export state at end of ice_export) per state index n, cell/column state entry/exit across ice_step (thermo, dynamics, transport), coupling-prep flux entry/exit, and the hemispheric budget on diagnostics steps.

regenerate.command: source stage1/runs/env.sh && python3 stage1/cesm/cime/scripts/create_newcase --case stage1/cime/cases/D_cice_inst --compset D --res f19_g17 --machine illinois --run-unsupported --srcroot stage1/EqESM-cesm-cice && cd stage1/cime/cases/D_cice_inst && ./xmlchange STOP_OPTION=ndays,STOP_N=1,NTASKS_ATM=18,NTASKS_ICE=18,NTASKS_OCN=18,NTASKS_ROF=18,NTASKS_GLC=18,NTASKS_WAV=18,NTASKS_CPL=18,NTASKS_ESP=1,NTHRDS=2 && ./case.setup && ./case.build && env -u SLURM_MEM_PER_NODE -u SLURM_MEM_PER_CPU -u SLURM_MEM_PER_GPU ./case.submit
regenerate.note: Model source root is the fork worktree stage1/EqESM-cesm-cice (branch instrument/cice-dumps; cice submodule @bcb9496, cice/src @2dbb70f, icepack @410ca07 untouched); CIME scripts come from the pristine checkout stage1/cesm/cime. Dump CSVs land in stage1/dumps/cice/ (set by dump_dir in user_nl_cice). Full dumps are gitignored and regenerable; the run takes ~1.5 min wall.

run.job_id: 12124251 (final cice_dedd.csv layout: recorder dummy lower bounds fixed to match the actuals - 0: for dzk/qs_k..ks_k/tau/w0/g/rdir_l..trnlay_l/trndir..dfdif, 1: for rsnw/rhosnw/frsnw/ki_ssl..gi_p_int/Sabs/Iabs/fthrul/aero_mp; prior runs 12118982 first dedd dump (all layer/interface arrays shifted +1 by the gfortran assumed-shape lbound-1 renormalization), 12122398 with the partial 0: fix (1-based arrays then shifted), 11864874/11857263/11857562 pre-dedd
run.result: COMPLETED exit 0:0, case.run success, model execution success; cice_dedd.csv 5760 rows x 383 cols fully aligned (fthrul_9 = visible flux@13, Iabs_8/Sabs_3/aero_mp_12 real, no denormal tails), 155520/155520 identity checks pass on the dump (27 per row, stage1/analysis/check_cice_dedd.py: fthrul_1..9 = visible flux@5..13; Sabs/Iabs/fsfc/fint/fthru running band sums with wghtns; avdr/avdf = band-1 rupdir(0)/rupdif(0); aidr/aidf band-2/3 sums; Sabs = 0 on bare rows); fthrul_9 = fthru only where the near-IR bands transmit nothing to the ice base (1662/1920 triples; elsewhere the IR tails are 1e-6..1e-2 W/m2)
run.dates: start 0001-01-01, STOP_OPTION=ndays STOP_N=1 (one day, 24 CICE timesteps of 3600 s)
run.coupling: ATM_NCPL=24 (dt=3600 s), CICE dynamics ndte=120, diagfreq=24
run.pes: TOTALPES=36 on 1 node (NTASKS=18 per component, NTHRDS=2; CICE on 18 PETs, dumps from PET 0 only)

namelist_deltas.note: All other settings identical to the reference run D_f19g17 (grid_ice='B', ncat=5, nilyr=8, nslyr=3, ktherm=2 mushy, advection='remap', kdyn=1, ndte=120, shortwave='dEdd', tfrz_option='mushy', diagfreq=24, block_size_x=20, block_size_y=24, distribution_type='sectrobin', revised_evp=.false.). Verified solution-neutral: the instrumented run's iceh and restart files are bit-identical (modulo title/timestamp attributes) to the reference run, so the dump code changes nothing when enabled. RERUN 11864874: fixed trcr/trcrn index order (declared (i,j,tracer,ncat,block), was read (i,tracer,j,n,block)) so thermo_state Tsfc/Tsfcn/qice/qsno and albedo Tsfcn/alvl/apnd/hpnd/ipnd columns now carry real values; solution-neutrality re-verified. RERUN 12118982 (first cice_dedd.csv): recorder dummies were declared 0: uniformly, but gfortran renormalizes assumed-shape dummies of explicit-shape actuals to lbound 1, so every 0-based layer/interface array (dzk, tau, w0, g, rdir_l..trnlay_l, trndir..dfdif, qs_k..ks_k) came out shifted +1 (garbage at index 0, last element dropped); 1-based arrays were correct. RERUN 12122398 (uniform 0: on everything): 0-based arrays aligned but the 1-based ones (fthrul, Sabs, Iabs, aero_mp) shifted +1 with denormal tails. RERUN 12124251 (per-array bounds, committed 04eecbf icepack / 5c879ee src / 8579a7c cice wrapper / a34b33d superproject): all 383 columns aligned - fthrul_1..9 = visible flux@5..13, Sabs = 0 on bare rows, Iabs/Sabs/aero_mp values real and consistent; 155520/155520 dump-law identity checks pass (check_cice_dedd.py); solution-neutrality re-verified (bit-identical iceh modulo case metadata).

traced_domain.cells: first 32 tmask cells of PET 0 (dump_first_cells=32) in block/(j,i) order, which matches the cap's 1-D state ordering (n = 1..numOwnedElements) so med2mod/mod2med_areacor apply by state index n; gi/gj are the global indices
traced_domain.steps: first 12 timesteps (dump_first_steps=12) of the 24-step day, plus step=0 initial-export rows in cice_run_exports and the step-24 budget row
traced_domain.steps_note: evp_stress has 32x4x120x12 = 184320 rows; evp_momentum 28x120x12 = 40320 rows because only 28 of the 32 traced T cells have ice-covered NE U corners (U points with ice only).

checks.freezing_temp_law: Tf = max(S/(-18.48 + 0.01848*S), -2.0) [shr_frz_freezetemp mushy, Assur 1958] to round-off on all 384 rows; identical to run_imports sss/Tf (re-verified by stage1/analysis/check_cice.py)
checks.evp_stress_law: newp/newm/new12 relaxation laws hold to round-off on all 184320 rows (552960 checks, stage1/analysis/check_cice.py; revp=0 classic EVP)
checks.evp_momentum_law: full chain vrel -> Cb -> cca/ccb -> ab2 -> cc1/cc2 -> uvel/vvel holds to round-off on all 40320 rows; final relations uvel=(cca*cc1+ccb*cc2)/ab2, vvel=(cca*cc2-ccb*cc1)/ab2 re-verified (80640 checks, stage1/analysis/check_cice.py)
checks.row_counts: thermo/dyn/transport state 32 cells x 5 ncat x 2 phases x 12 steps = 3840 rows each; transport_tracers 3840 rows too (same two call sites); albedo 32x5x12 = 1920; thermo_flux/ice_strength 32x12 = 384; flux 32x2x12 = 768; imports 32x12 = 384; exports 32x13 = 416 (incl. step 0); budget 1 row at step 24; dedd 32x5x12 triples x 3 bands = 5760 rows (srftyp 1 snow 1884 triples, srftyp 0 bare 36 triples, no srftyp 2 pond rows: the effective pond fraction from shortwave_dEdd_set_eff is 0 on every traced row - fresh-snow/fracn masking and the rp < 0.15 buried-snow test - even though the apndn/hpndn tracers are nonzero, max 0.13/0.041 m; fi column = coverage of the surface type passed to the call, 1.0 everywhere); thermo_state Tsfc/Tsfcn now physical (e.g. Tsfc ~ -14.7 C, qice_1 ~ -3.03e8 J/m3); all row counts re-verified by stage1/analysis/check_cice.py
checks.no_blank_lines: fixed in 2dbb70f: evp_stress and freezing_temp previously emitted a blank line after every data row; all 14 CSVs now have zero blank lines (re-verified by stage1/analysis/check_cice.py)
checks.dedd_identity_laws: 155520/155520 checks pass (27 per row x 5760 rows, stage1/analysis/check_cice_dedd.py, rtol/atol 1e-12): fthrul_1..9 = visible flux at interfaces 5..13 (dfdir*swvdr + dfdif*swvdf of the triple's ns=1 row); avdr/avdf = ns=1 row's rupdir(0)/rupdif(0); aidr/aidf = running sums of rupdir(0)/rupdif(0)*wghtns(ns) over bands 2..3 with wghtns(2)=0.67+0.11*(1-fnidr), wghtns(3)=1-wghtns(2); Sabs_1..3 (0 on bare rows), Iabs_1..8 (with the snow-covered top-layer km=4/kp=6 indexing), fsfc/fint/fthru = running band sums 1..ns(row) of the per-band flux differences, wghtns applied exactly as the Fortran forms them
checks.dedd_dump_composition: each triple's three rows share the cell state and inputs; layer/interface arrays are per-band; the visible band sets fthrul/avdr/avdf once and the near-IR bands accumulate aidr/aidf, so those columns are constant across the triple while fsfc/fint/fthru/Sabs/Iabs grow; fthrul_9 = fthru only where the near-IR bands transmit nothing to the ice base (1662/1920 triples; the rest carry IR tails of 1e-6..1e-2 W/m2, not exact zeros)
